name: Psychology Effects (Hindi)
style: Hinglish in Devanagari, the way a friend tells a story: everyday Hindi + English words Indians really say in English (CEO, deal, billion, percent, share, market). Captions keep digits; the `voice` field spells every number/symbol/abbreviation as spoken in Hinglish (e.g. 2011 → twenty eleven, Q3 → क्यू थ्री, 49.4% → forty nine point four percent).
structure: 1 HOOK (<=14 words): 'क्या आपके साथ भी...' style relatable moment or surprising question
3 THE STUDY: researcher, year, what they found (real, sourced)
4 EVERYDAY EXAMPLE the viewer recognises (phone, exams, relationships, shopping)
6 HOW TO USE IT / PROTECT YOURSELF (one practical tip)
7 PUNCHLINE / question that makes them comment
sceneMix: Mostly collage with people/emotion photos + kinetic for the effect name; one chart only if the study has numbers; end scene last. Avoid medical/diagnostic claims.

voice.name: Monika Sogam - Calm and Natural
voice.note: Natural speed 1.0 — never speed the voice up to fit; cut words instead. Put a long pause (<break time="1.1s" />) between lines so captions and scene cuts line up.

variety.rule: Every episode picks a NEW combination: look ≠ previous Short, hookType not in last 2, captionStyle+transition not in last 3, opening 3 scene types not in last 5, music not in last 5. Choose by the story's emotion, not at random: rise/success → gold/lightleak; fall/failure → noir or archive + smoke/embers; tech/internet → neon + glitch; history/old India → paper or archive; modern startup → clean.
